model_info.name: ShelfBracket_v1
model_info.author: Marcel Rienks
model_info.description: Corner bracket to support shelves in a parametric shelving system. Used to hold vertical posts and horizontal shelves. Needs to support moderate loads (up to 20kg per bracket in typical use).
model_info.assembly_context: Part of a larger modular shelving assembly system. Works with vertical posts (40x40mm aluminum) and horizontal shelf components. This is the corner connector piece.

critical_features.name: Critical Features
critical_features.description: Four M3 mounting holes in corners (3.2mm diameter). These must be positioned exactly to align with post connector holes. Wall thickness minimum 2mm for structural strength. All internal edges rounded at least 1mm to prevent stress concentration.

design_decisions.rationale: Tapered walls (thicker near mounting points, thinner in middle sections) to reduce weight while maintaining strength. Reinforcement ribs on internal faces to improve stiffness. Corner radii set at 1.5mm minimum for FDM print quality (smaller radii tend to fail).

design_intent.aesthetic_requirements: Smooth external surfaces for professional appearance. Symmetrical design makes it work equally well in any orientation. No sharp edges for safety when handling.
design_intent.load_requirements: Corner bracket to support shelves in a parametric shelving system. Used to hold vertical posts and horizontal shelves. Needs to support moderate loads (up to 20kg per bracket in typical use).

materials.material_type: PLA plastic (Prusament PLA Pro or equivalent)
materials.fabrication_method: FDM 3D printing on Prusa i3 MK3S+. Layer height: 0.15mm. Infill: 15% gyroid. Support: tree supports where needed.
materials.material_considerations: No draft angles needed (not molded). PLA shrinks slightly (0.3-0.5%) after cooling. Minimum wall thickness 1.5mm for reliability. Sharp corners/edges fail first under load, so all corners rounded. Overhangs less than 45° print reliably without support.
materials.post_processing: Post-print processing: Remove support structures, sand smooth any rough edges with 220 grit sandpaper. Optional: UV stabilizer coating to prevent yellowing. No painting (keep natural PLA finish).

variations.planned_variants: Three standard sizes for different shelf widths: Small (100mm) for compact shelves, Medium (200mm) for standard shelves, Large (300mm) for wide shelves. Also planned: left/right handed versions (mirror images). Future: material variations (flexible TPU version for adjustable shelves).
variations.variant_examples: Small bracket: width 100mm. Medium bracket: width 200mm. Large bracket: width 300mm. Left-hand: normal orientation. Right-hand: mirrored 180° (same part, different mounting).
variations.variable_parameters: Only the base width parameter varies between sizes. Depth (150mm), thickness (10mm), and all hole positions remain constant. This means a single parameterized script can generate all size variations.
